The store lives under the active profile's\n * data root (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/mimotts-recordings`; the legacy global\n * `~/.dsh` when no profile is active), outside the plugin and any repository,\n * so no recording leaks into version control.\n *\n * Re-synthesis never overwrites: it adds a new version, leaving earlier\n * takes intact so the user can compare voices side by side.\n * @module dsh-mimotts/recordings\n */\nimport { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';\nimport { homedir } from 'node:os';\nimport { mkdir, readFile, writeFile, unlink } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport { join } from 'node:path';\nimport { profileScopedDefault } from './profile-dir.js';\n/** The legacy home-level store, used when no DSH profile is active. */\nconst LEGACY_RECORDINGS_DIR = join(homedir(), '.dsh', 'mimotts-recordings');\n// Resolved lazily on first use and cached: the profile signals (env, argv,\n// install location) only settle once the harness process is up, and the store\n// must stay in one place for the process lifetime.\nlet cachedDir;\nfunction recordingsDir() {\n    if (cachedDir === undefined) {\n        cachedDir = profileScopedDefault('mimotts-recordings') ?? LEGACY_RECORDINGS_DIR;\n    }\n    return cachedDir;\n}\n/** The single index file mapping texts to their version trees. */\nfunction indexFile() {\n    return join(recordingsDir(), 'index.json');\n}\n/** A recordings store with no entries yet. */\nconst EMPTY_INDEX = { entries: [] };\n// `mkdir` is idempotent but we still memoize the in-flight promise so\n// concurrent first writes don't race the directory creation.\nlet ensurePromise;\nfunction ensureDir() {\n    if (ensurePromise === undefined) {\n        ensurePromise = mkdir(recordingsDir(), { recursive: true })\n            .then(() => undefined)\n            .catch((error) => {\n            ensurePromise = undefined;\n            throw error;\n        });\n    }\n    return ensurePromise;\n}\n/**\n * Read the index, tolerating a missing or corrupt file.\n * @returns the parsed index, or an empty one when unreadable.\n */\nasync function readIndex() {\n    try {\n        const raw = await readFile(indexFile(), 'utf8');\n        const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);\n        return Array.isArray(parsed.entries) ? parsed : EMPTY_INDEX;\n    }\n    catch {\n        return EMPTY_INDEX;\n    }\n}\n/** Persist the index, creating the directory first. */\nasync function writeIndex(index) {\n    await ensureDir();\n    await writeFile(indexFile(), JSON.stringify(index), 'utf8');\n}\n/** The on-disk file name for one version; ids are uuids, so no path tricks. */\nfunction versionFileName(recId, verId) {\n    return `${recId}-${verId}.wav`;\n}\n/** Absolute path of one version's WAV file. */\nexport function versionFilePath(recId, verId) {\n    return join(recordingsDir(), versionFileName(recId, verId));\n}\n/**\n * Append a synthesized version to a text's recording history.\n *\n * Texts are de-duplicated: speaking the same text twice groups both takes\n * under one node. The new version is prepended so the list reads newest-first.\n * @param text - the spoken text (grouping key).\n * @param style - style phrase used, or undefined for neutral.\n * @param voice - preset voice used, or undefined for default.\n * @param model - model id used.\n * @param wav - the WAV bytes to persist.\n * @returns the recording node and the new version.\n */\nexport async function addVersion(text, style, voice, model, wav) {\n    await ensureDir();\n    const index = await readIndex();\n    const version = {\n        id: randomUUID(),\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        style: style ?? null,\n        voice: voice ?? null,\n        model,\n    };\n    let recording = index.entries.find(entry => entry.text === text);\n    if (recording === undefined) {\n        recording = { id: randomUUID(), text, createdAt: version.createdAt, versions: [] };\n        index.entries.unshift(recording);\n    }\n    recording.versions.unshift(version);\n    await writeFile(versionFilePath(recording.id, version.id), Buffer.from(wav));\n    await writeIndex(index);\n    return { recording, version };\n}\n/** Return the current index (empty when none yet). */\nexport async function listRecordings() {\n    return readIndex();\n}\n/**\n * Re-synthesize an existing recording's text with the engine's current\n * settings and append the result as a new version. Earlier versions stay\n * intact so the user can compare takes.\n * @param recId - the recording node id.\n * @param style - style phrase used, or undefined for neutral.\n * @param voice - preset voice used, or undefined for default.\n * @param model - model id used.\n * @param wav - the freshly synthesized WAV bytes.\n * @returns the recording and new version, or undefined when `recId` is unknown.\n */\nexport async function resynthesize(recId, style, voice, model, wav) {\n    await ensureDir();\n    const index = await readIndex();\n    const recording = index.entries.find(entry => entry.id === recId);\n    if (recording === undefined)\n        return undefined;\n    const version = {\n        id: randomUUID(),\n        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n        style: style ?? null,\n        voice: voice ?? null,\n        model,\n    };\n    recording.versions.unshift(version);\n    await writeFile(versionFilePath(recording.id, version.id), Buffer.from(wav));\n    await writeIndex(index);\n    return { recording, version };\n}\n/**\n * Delete one version's file and index entry. When a recording loses its last\n * version it is removed entirely.\n * @returns true when the version existed and was removed.\n */\nexport async function deleteVersion(recId, verId) {\n    const index = await readIndex();\n    const recording = index.entries.find(entry => entry.id === recId);\n    if (recording === undefined)\n        return false;\n    const at = recording.versions.findIndex(version => version.id === verId);\n    if (at === -1)\n        return false;\n    recording.versions.splice(at, 1);\n    await unlink(versionFilePath(recId, verId)).catch(() => { });\n    if (recording.versions.length === 0) {\n        index.entries = index.entries.filter(entry => entry.id !== recId);\n    }\n    await writeIndex(index);\n    return true;\n}\n/** Whether a recording/version pair exists (used to authorize file serving). */\nexport async function hasVersion(recId, verId) {\n    const index = await readIndex();\n    const recording = index.entries.find(entry => entry.id === recId);\n    return recording !== undefined && recording.versions.some(version => version.id === verId);\n}\n//# sourceMappingURL=recordings.js.map"

      "content": "/**\n * Settings and route vocabulary shared by the Host and browser halves.\n *\n * Both bundles inline this file, so it must stay pure: constants and types\n * only, no Node or DOM APIs. The namespace is the profile entry id the bundle\n * patch inserts (`cordis.patch.yml`), and the route paths are the seam the two\n * halves meet on.\n * @module dsh-mimotts/settings\n */\n/** Settings namespace: the profile entry id of this plugin's loader row. */\nexport const MIMOTTS_NAMESPACE = 'mimotts';\n/**\n * Key this plugin's configuration card registers under on the Plugins page's\n * `plugins.bundle.config` keyed slot: the bundle's npm package name, which is\n * the keying convention the Plugins page fixes for bundle-owned configuration\n * (the page dispatches with `entryKey: pkg.name`).\n */\nexport const MIMOTTS_PACKAGE_KEY = '@gw/dsh-mimotts';\n/** Route prefix owned by this plugin on `ctx.webServer`. */\nexport const MIMOTTS_API_PREFIX = '/api/mimotts';\n/** `GET` route reporting the resolved engine configuration without secrets. */\nexport const MIMOTTS_STATUS_PATH = `${MIMOTTS_API_PREFIX}/status`;\n/** `POST` route synthesizing one text into WAV audio. */\nexport const MIMOTTS_SYNTHESIZE_PATH = `${MIMOTTS_API_PREFIX}/synthesize`;\n/** MiMo platform endpoint base; `/chat/completions` is appended. */\nexport const DEFAULT_BASE_URL = 'https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1';\n/** MiMo TTS model id. */\nexport const DEFAULT_MODEL = 'mimo-v2.5-tts';\n/** Preset voice used when no clone sample is configured. */\nexport const DEFAULT_VOICE = 'mimo_default';\n/**\n * Credential reference naming the MiMo API key inside the host credentials\n * store; the literal key itself never lands in a configuration file.\n */\nexport const DEFAULT_CREDENTIAL_REF = 'MIMO_API_KEY';\n/** Longest text one synthesis accepts, in characters. */\nexport const DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS = 2000;\n/** Upper bound on one upstream round-trip, in milliseconds. */\nexport const DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;\n/** Sample sentence the settings page's audition button speaks. */\nexport const AUDITION_TEXT = '你好，这是 MiMo 语音合成的试听效果。';\n/** Route prefix for persisted speech history (list / create / file). */\nexport const MIMOTTS_RECORDINGS_PATH = `${MIMOTTS_API_PREFIX}/recordings`;\n/**\n * Response header carrying the new recording identity. Its value is the\n * base64 encoding of `JSON.stringify({ recId, verId })` so it survives the\n * `audio/wav` body that the synthesize route streams back.\n */\nexport const MIMOTTS_RECORDING_HEADER = 'x-mimotts-recording';\n//# sourceMappingURL=settings.js.map"

      "content": "/**\n * MiMo TTS engine client.\n *\n * Speaks text through the MiMo platform's OpenAI-shaped `/chat/completions`\n * endpoint with an `audio` output block: the request carries the text as an\n * assistant message (optionally prefixed with a `<style>…</style>` phrase), and\n * the response carries base64 audio in `choices[0].message.audio.data`. Voice\n * cloning swaps the preset `audio.voice` for an `audio.voice_audio` reference\n * clip. Raw PCM responses are wrapped as WAV so the browser can seek.\n * @module dsh-mimotts/tts\n */\nimport { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';\nimport { clampText, toSpeakableText } from \"./normalize.js\";\nimport { isRiffWav, wrapPcmAsWav } from \"./wav.js\";\nimport { DEFAULT_BASE_URL, DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS, DEFAULT_MODEL, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS, DEFAULT_VOICE, } from \"./settings.js\";\n/** A synthesis failure carrying a stable, UI-mappable code. */\nexport class TtsError extends Error {\n    code;\n    cause;\n    /**\n     * @param code - stable failure code returned to the browser.\n     * @param message - human-readable detail; never contains secrets.\n     * @param cause - upstream failure, when one raised this error.\n     */\n    constructor(code, message, cause) {\n        super(message);\n        this.code = code;\n        this.cause = cause;\n        this.name = 'TtsError';\n    }\n}\nconst nodeDeps = {\n    fetch: (...args) => globalThis.fetch(...args),\n    readVoiceSample: async (path) => new Uint8Array(await readFile(path)),\n};\n/**\n * Resolve a settings section into the engine configuration a synthesis runs\n * with. Defaults live here rather than at the use site, so every caller sees\n * fully defaulted values (the schema defaults are for the settings form).\n * @param section - the resolved settings section (fields may be blank).\n * @returns the engine configuration for one synthesis.\n */\nexport function resolveEngineConfig(section) {\n    return {\n        apiKey: (section.apiKey ?? '').trim(),\n        baseUrl: (section.baseUrl ?? '').trim() || DEFAULT_BASE_URL,\n        model: (section.model ?? '').trim() || DEFAULT_MODEL,\n        voice: (section.voice ?? '').trim() || DEFAULT_VOICE,\n        voiceSamplePath: (section.voiceSamplePath ?? '').trim(),\n        style: (section.style ?? '').trim(),\n        maxChars: typeof section.maxChars === 'number' && section.maxChars > 0\n            ? Math.floor(section.maxChars)\n            : DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS,\n        timeoutMs: typeof section.timeoutMs === 'number' && section.timeoutMs > 0\n            ? Math.floor(section.timeoutMs)\n            : DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS,\n    };\n}\n/**\n * Synthesize one text into WAV audio.\n *\n * The text is normalized first (Markdown decoration is never spoken), then\n * clamped to the configured budget — a long reply speaks its opening rather\n * than being refused.\n * @param config - resolved engine configuration.\n * @param request - text and optional style/voice overrides.\n * @param deps - transport and filesystem seam; defaults to real `fetch`/`fs`.\n * @returns a complete WAV file.\n * @throws {TtsError} when the request is unusable or the provider fails.\n */\nexport async function synthesizeSpeech(config, request, deps = nodeDeps) {\n    if (config.apiKey === '') {\n        throw new TtsError('not-configured', 'No MiMo API key is configured; add the credential in the credentials store and reference it in Settings → 语音合成.');\n    }\n    const speakable = clampText(toSpeakableText(request.text ?? ''), config.maxChars);\n    if (speakable === '') {\n        throw new TtsError('bad-request', 'The message carries no speakable text.');\n    }\n    const style = (request.style ?? '').trim() || config.style;\n    const content = style === '' ? speakable : `<style>${style}</style>${speakable}`;\n    const voice = (request.voice ?? '').trim() || config.voice;\n    let audio;\n    if (config.voiceSamplePath !== '') {\n        let sample;\n        try {\n            sample = await deps.readVoiceSample(config.voiceSamplePath);\n        }\n        catch (cause) {\n            throw new TtsError('voice-sample-unreadable', `The voice-clone sample at ${config.voiceSamplePath} could not be read.`, cause);\n        }\n        audio = {\n            format: 'wav',\n            voice_audio: { format: 'wav', data: Buffer.from(sample).toString('base64') },\n        };\n    }\n    else {\n        audio = { format: 'wav', voice };\n    }\n    const payload = {\n        model: config.model,\n        audio,\n        messages: [{ role: 'assistant', content }],\n    };\n    const endpoint = `${config.baseUrl.replace(/\\/+$/, '')}/chat/completions`;\n    let response;\n    try {\n        response = await deps.fetch(endpoint, {\n            method: 'POST',\n            headers: {\n                'content-type': 'application/json',\n                'api-key': config.apiKey,\n                'user-agent': 'dsh-mimotts/0.1.0',\n            },\n            body: JSON.stringify(payload),\n            signal: AbortSignal.timeout(config.timeoutMs),\n        });\n    }\n    catch (cause) {\n        const timedOut = cause instanceof Error && cause.name === 'TimeoutError';\n        throw new TtsError(timedOut ? 'timeout' : 'upstream-error', timedOut\n            ? `MiMo TTS did not answer within ${config.timeoutMs} ms.`\n            : `MiMo TTS could not be reached: ${cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause)}`, cause);\n    }\n    if (!response.ok) {\n        const detail = await response.text().catch(() => '');\n        throw new TtsError('upstream-error', `MiMo TTS returned HTTP ${response.status}${detail === '' ? '' : `: ${detail.slice(0, 300)}`}`);\n    }\n    let body;\n    try {\n        body = await response.json();\n    }\n    catch (cause) {\n        throw new TtsError('invalid-audio', 'MiMo TTS returned a response that is not JSON.', cause);\n    }\n    const data = decodeAudioData(body);\n    if (isRiffWav(data))\n        return data;\n    return wrapPcmAsWav(data);\n}\n/**\n * Pull the base64 audio block out of the provider response.\n * @param body - parsed `chat.completion` response.\n * @returns decoded audio bytes (WAV or raw PCM).\n * @throws {TtsError} when the response carries an error or no audio block.\n */\nfunction decodeAudioData(body) {\n    const root = body;\n    if (root === null || typeof root !== 'object') {\n        throw new TtsError('invalid-audio', 'MiMo TTS returned an empty response.');\n    }\n    if (root.error !== undefined && root.error !== null) {\n        const detail = typeof root.error === 'object' && 'message' in root.error\n            ? String(root.error.message)\n            : JSON.stringify(root.error);\n        throw new TtsError('upstream-error', `MiMo TTS reported an error: ${detail.slice(0, 300)}`);\n    }\n    const encoded = root.choices?.[0]?.message?.audio?.data;\n    if (typeof encoded !== 'string' || encoded === '') {\n        throw new TtsError('invalid-audio', 'MiMo TTS returned no audio block in choices[0].message.audio.data.');\n    }\n    const data = new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(encoded, 'base64'));\n    if (data.length === 0)\n        throw new TtsError('invalid-audio', 'MiMo TTS returned an empty audio block.');\n    return data;\n}\n//# sourceMappingURL=tts.js.map"

      "path": "lib/node/wav.js",
      "content": "/**\n * WAV container helpers.\n *\n * The MiMo TTS endpoint returns either a complete WAV (RIFF) or raw PCM;\n * browsers need a container to seek, so raw PCM is wrapped as 24 kHz / 16-bit\n * mono PCM — the format the endpoint documents for its audio output.\n * @module dsh-mimotts/wav\n */\n/** Sample rate the MiMo TTS endpoint emits raw PCM at. */\nexport const PCM_SAMPLE_RATE = 24_000;\n/** Bits per sample the MiMo TTS endpoint emits raw PCM at. */\nexport const PCM_BITS_PER_SAMPLE = 16;\n/** Channel count the MiMo TTS endpoint emits raw PCM at. */\nexport const PCM_CHANNELS = 1;\n/**\n * Test whether the bytes already carry a RIFF/WAVE container.\n * @param bytes - audio payload as decoded from the provider response.\n * @returns true when the payload starts with a `RIFF…WAVE` header.\n */\nexport function isRiffWav(bytes) {\n    return bytes.length >= 12\n        && bytes[0] === 0x52 && bytes[1] === 0x49 && bytes[2] === 0x46 && bytes[3] === 0x46 // RIFF\n        && bytes[8] === 0x57 && bytes[9] === 0x41 && bytes[10] === 0x56 && bytes[11] === 0x45; // WAVE\n}\n/**\n * Wrap raw PCM samples in a minimal canonical WAV container.\n *\n * The layout is the 44-byte `RIFF`/`fmt `/`data` header every browser audio\n * decoder seeks: no `fact` chunk, no extended format.\n * @param pcm - interleaved little-endian PCM samples.\n * @param sampleRate - samples per second per channel.\n * @param bitsPerSample - bits per sample.\n * @param channels - channel count.\n * @returns a complete WAV file.\n */\nexport function wrapPcmAsWav(pcm, sampleRate = PCM_SAMPLE_RATE, bitsPerSample = PCM_BITS_PER_SAMPLE, channels = PCM_CHANNELS) {\n    const blockAlign = (channels * bitsPerSample) / 8;\n    const byteRate = sampleRate * blockAlign;\n    const wav = new Uint8Array(44 + pcm.length);\n    const view = new DataView(wav.buffer);\n    const ascii = (offset, text) => {\n        for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1)\n            wav[offset + index] = text.charCodeAt(index);\n    };\n    ascii(0, 'RIFF');\n    view.setUint32(4, 36 + pcm.length, true);\n    ascii(8, 'WAVE');\n    ascii(12, 'fmt ');\n    view.setUint32(16, 16, true); // PCM fmt chunk size\n    view.setUint16(20, 1, true); // format: PCM\n    view.setUint16(22, channels, true);\n    view.setUint32(24, sampleRate, true);\n    view.setUint32(28, byteRate, true);\n    view.setUint16(32, blockAlign, true);\n    view.setUint16(34, bitsPerSample, true);\n    ascii(36, 'data');\n    view.setUint32(40, pcm.length, true);\n    wav.set(pcm, 44);\n    return wav;\n}\n//# sourceMappingURL=wav.js.map"

      "path": "tests/recordings.test.mjs",
      "content": "import test from 'node:test'\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict'\nimport { addVersion, deleteVersion, hasVersion, listRecordings, resynthesize } from '../lib/node/recordings.js'\n\nconst WAV = new Uint8Array([0x52, 0x49, 0x46, 0x46, 1, 2, 3, 4])\n\n// Exercises the real store under ~/.dsh/mimotts-recordings and removes every\n// trace it creates, so the user's own history is left untouched.\ntest('recordings: add → list → resynthesize → delete lifecycle', async () => {\n  const text = `语音历史自测-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`\n  const { recording, version } = await addVersion(text, '开心', 'mimo_default', 'mimo-v2.5-tts', WAV)\n  assert.ok(recording.id, 'recording gets an id')\n  assert.equal(recording.text, text)\n  assert.equal(version.style, '开心')\n  assert.equal(await hasVersion(recording.id, version.id), true)\n\n  let index = await listRecordings()\n  let node = index.entries.find(entry => entry.id === recording.id)\n  assert.ok(node, 'node is listed')\n  assert.equal(node.versions.length, 1)\n\n  const re = await resynthesize(recording.id, undefined, undefined, 'mimo-v2.5-tts', WAV)\n  assert.ok(re, 're-synthesis returns a version')\n  index = await listRecordings()\n  node = index.entries.find(entry => entry.id === recording.id)\n  assert.equal(node.versions.length, 2, 'a new version is appended, old kept')\n\n  await deleteVersion(recording.id, version.id)\n  index = await listRecordings()\n  node = index.entries.find(entry => entry.id === recording.id)\n  assert.equal(node.versions.length, 1, 'one version removed')\n\n  // Remove the remaining version; the node should disappear entirely.\n  await deleteVersion(recording.id, node.versions[0].id)\n  index = await listRecordings()\n  assert.equal(index.entries.find(entry => entry.id === recording.id), undefined, 'node gone after last version')\n})\n\ntest('recordings: groups repeated text under one node', async () => {\n  const text = `语音历史分组自测-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`\n  const first = await addVersion(text, undefined, undefined, 'mimo-v2.5-tts', WAV)\n  const second = await addVersion(text, undefined, undefined, 'mimo-v2.5-tts', WAV)\n  assert.equal(first.recording.id, second.recording.id, 'same text → same node')\n  assert.equal(second.recording.versions.length, 2, 'both takes grouped')\n\n  // Clean up the whole node.\n  for (const v of second.recording.versions) await deleteVersion(second.recording.id, v.id)\n})\n"

      "content": "import test from 'node:test'\nimport assert from 'node:assert/strict'\nimport { resolveEngineConfig, synthesizeSpeech, TtsError } from '../lib/node/tts.js'\nimport { isRiffWav } from assert.equal(captured.audio.voice, undefined)\n  assert.deepEqual(captured.audio.voice_audio, { format: 'wav', data: Buffer.from([9, 9]).toString('base64') })\n})\n\ntest('synthesizeSpeech passes a
